title: Hosea Bible Quiz - Chapter 11
description: Ten questions on Hosea 11: Israel called out of Egypt, the Assyrian king, and God's compassion for Ephraim.

questions.text: According to verse 1, what did God do when Israel was a child?
questions.explanation: Verse 1 says that when Israel was a child God loved him and called his son out of Egypt.

answers.text: He loved him and called his son out of Egypt
He sent him down into Egypt
He hid him in the wilderness
He gave him a king and princes

questions.text: To what did the people burn incense, according to verse 2?
questions.explanation: They sacrificed to the Baals and burned incense to engraved images.

questions.text: What does God say he taught Ephraim to do?
questions.explanation: God says he taught Ephraim to walk and took them by his arms, but they did not know that he healed them.

questions.text: With what did God draw them, according to verse 4?
questions.explanation: He drew them with cords of a man and with ties of love, and he bent down to him and fed him.

answers.text: With chains of iron and fetters
With a rod and a shepherd's staff
With a heavy yoke of wood
With cords of a man and ties of love

questions.text: Who will be their king, because they refused to repent?
questions.explanation: They will not return into the land of Egypt, but the Assyrian will be their king, because they refused to repent.

questions.text: What will the sword destroy when it falls on their cities?
questions.explanation: The sword will fall on their cities, destroy the bars of their gates and put an end to their plans.

questions.text: Which two places does God name when he asks how he can treat Ephraim?
questions.explanation: God asks how he can make Ephraim like Admah and like Zeboiim, and says his heart is turned within him.

questions.text: What reason does God give for not executing the fierceness of his anger?
questions.explanation: He will not return to destroy Ephraim, for he is God and not man, the Holy One among them.

answers.text: Ephraim has turned back to him
The prophets have prayed for the people
He is God and not man, the Holy One among them
A remnant has kept his statutes

questions.text: Like what will they come out of the land of Assyria, according to verse 11?
questions.explanation: They will come trembling like a bird out of Egypt and like a dove out of the land of Assyria, and God will settle them in their houses.

questions.text: With what does the house of Israel surround God, according to verse 12?
questions.explanation: Ephraim surrounds him with falsehood and the house of Israel with deceit.
